name: ankle circles
interpretation: Twelve-second seated demonstration: left leg lifts45mm, one slow counterclockwise ankle circle, a direction-change pause, one clockwise circle and lower; then repeat on the right. Direction is measured from the actual toe-vector path in frontal X/Z projection, viewed from the toes toward the body. Legs remain extended forward with a gentle authored knee bend. Source repetition count is unspecified.

source.description: Sit and move your foot in slow circles from the ankle. It warms up the ankle joint and the muscles around the calf.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Lift one leg off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then switch to the other direction.
